custom.message: A class string of 4+ utilities appears more than twice in apps/convergence/src and packages/ui/src: the third copy is a @convergence/ui part or a shared constant (scripts/guards/repeated-classes.json has the settings and the allowlist, each entry with its reason; MAR-3613).

jscpd found copied code in apps/convergence/src or packages/ui/src (.jscpd.json has the settings): make the copy a shared part, or keep it on purpose in scripts/guards/copied-code.json, or between jscpd:ignore-start and jscpd:ignore-end, and say why (MAR-3613).

A size handed to a Button, a Notice, a Badge or a field through a name (a constant, an object's member, a function that returns classes) or a wrapper's className: R3 makes a size a prop, and a name that hands one on is a className too. Take the part's size (Button xs to xl; Notice and Badge size; a field's size and density="compact"), make the row the part it is, or keep one on purpose in scripts/guards/sizes-in-constants.json's allowlist with its reason (MAR-3608, DS8).
